en.headline: Water Supplies Department says Shau Kei Wan black particles are asphalt and meet standards
en.dek: The department said samples from affected areas contained trace asphalt from pipe linings raised during post-repair flushing, but all met Hong Kong drinking water standards and supply has cleared.
body: The Water Supplies Department said black particles reported by residents in Shau Kei Wan and nearby areas after a water main repair were asphalt from protective linings inside upstream steel pipes.

A main on Shau Kei Wan Road was damaged during roadworks on 27 October, interrupting supply to more than 10,000 households in Shau Kei Wan, Sai Wan Ho and Aldrich Bay for up to 12 hours. After restoration, some residents reported black spots in their water and darkening of filters.

The department said it received enquiries and sent teams to inspect, flush meters and internal systems, and help clean building storage tanks. Laboratory tests on samples showed the particles included inert asphalt, but every sample met the Hong Kong drinking water standards. Officials said the water does not affect health and the supply has returned to clear.

The affected asphalt-lined section is already part of a replacement programme that began in October 2025. Temporary pipes are being laid, with a connection targeted by the end of this year and permanent works expected to finish in January 2028.

zh.headline: 水務署指筲箕灣食水黑點為瀝青 化驗符合標準
zh.dek: 署方表示受影響地區樣本含維修後沖洗揚起的微量瀝青，但全部符合香港食水標準，供水已回復清澈。
body: 水務署表示，筲箕灣及附近地區居民在水管維修後反映的食水黑點，是來自上游鋼管內壁瀝青保護層。
10月27日路政署承辦商在筲箕灣道施工時意外鑿穿一條水管，導致筲箕灣、西灣河及愛秩序灣逾萬戶停水最長約12小時。恢復供水後，部分居民發現食水有黑點，濾芯迅速變黑。
署方接獲查詢後已派員到場視察，協助沖洗水錶及內部系統，並清洗大廈貯水缸。化驗顯示部分樣本含微量惰性瀝青，但所有樣本均符合《香港食水標準》，不會影響健康，供水已回復清澈。
有關採用瀝青內層的管段已納入改善工程，工程去年10月展開，正敷設臨時喉管，爭取今年底接駁，永久工程預計2028年1月完成。
